hero.headline: Inda rahotannin 'yan ƙasa ke isa ga ƙaramar hukuma
hero.sub: CivicOS yana ba unguwarka, ƙaramar hukumarka, da jiharka rikodin jama'a guda ɗaya don matsalolin yau da kullum — daga transfoma da suka lalace da hanyoyin da ba a yi ba zuwa koƙe-koƙen al'umma. Bayar da rahoton matsaloli, biyo amsoshin hukuma, kuma ka ga abin da aka gyara.

citizens.body: Shaida matsalolin gida cikin ƙasa da minti biyu, sa hannu kan koƙe-koƙen al'umma da aka tabbatar, kuma ka biyo ci gaban hukuma daga rahoto na farko har zuwa warwarewa.

reps.title: Nuna wa masu zaɓenka abin da kake kawowa
reps.body: Amsa kai tsaye ga koƙe-koƙen jama'a, fitar da sabuntawar ci gaba, kuma ka gina tarihin amsawa da aka tabbatar a unguwarka ko ƙaramar hukumarka.

government.title: Mayar da ƙorafe-ƙorafe marasa tsari zuwa bayanan filin da suka bayyana
government.body: Tura rahotannin da suke shigowa zuwa sashen da ya dace, aika ma'aikatan gyara, kuma ka ba mazauna hujjar aikin da aka yi.

ngos.title: Ka gina shawarwarinka a kan bayanan al'umma na gaske
ngos.body: Gano yanayin ababen more rayuwa a faɗin ƙananan hukumomi, tallafa wa koƙe-koƙen mazauna da hujja mai tsari, kuma auna tasirin manufofi cikin lokaci.

articles.marker: Abin da za ka iya yi a nan
articles.title: Duk abin da kake buƙata don ka riƙe shugabancin gida da alhaki

issues.title: Shigar da rahotanni da ba za su ɓace a cikin akwatin saƙo ba
issues.body: Ɗauki hoto, haɗa wuri, kuma ka shaida matsaloli kamar bututun ruwa da ya fashe, magudanar ruwa a buɗe, ko rashin ɗaukar shara. Rahotonka yana shiga rikodin jama'a wanda ofisoshin gida za su iya sa ido kuma su warware.

petitions.title: Tara unguwarka da koƙe-koƙen da aka tabbatar
petitions.body: Fara koƙe-koƙen al'umma da burin sa hannu bayyananne don unguwarka ko ƙaramar hukumarka. Ɗan ƙasa ɗaya da aka tabbatar yana daidai da sa hannu ɗaya — babu spam na bot, babu maimaitawa — don lambobinka su kasance da nauyi na gaske.

reps.title: Sanya amsoshin wakilai a kan rikodin
reps.body: Biyo kansilan unguwarka, shugaban ƙaramar hukuma, ko wakilin majalisarka. Idan sun amsa matsalar al'umma ko koƙe, ana adana maganarsu a bayyane a bayanin martabarsu don kowa ya gani.

discover.title: Jerin gida da aka tsara don unguwarka
discover.body: Ka mai da hankali kan abin da ke shafar rayuwarka ta yau da kullum. Jerinka yana ba fifiko ga rahotanni da sabuntawa daga titinka, unguwarka, da ƙaramar hukumarka kafin ya nuna ayyukan jihar.

notifications.title: Ka san lokacin da wani abu ya motsa
notifications.body: Ka samu sanarwa idan wakili ya amsa, koƙe ya cimma burin sa hannu, ko matsalar da kake bi ta canza matsayi zuwa an warware.

transparency.title: Babu abin da ke ɓacewa a shiru
transparency.body: Kowane rahoto, sa hannu, da amsar hukuma yana da alamar lokaci kuma ana ajiye shi a rikodin jama'a. Bayanan tuntuɓarka da adireshin gidanka sun rage na sirri.

principles.marker: Abin da muke riƙe kanmu da shi
principles.title: An rubuta kafin lambar, kuma har yanzu yana ɗaure mu

transparency.label: Bayyane
transparency.body: Kowane rahoto, sa hannu, da amsar hukuma yana zama a rikodin jama'a.

participation.label: Shiga
participation.body: Kowane mazauni zai iya shigarwa, sa hannu, kuma ya biyo baya — kyauta, a kowace daga cikin harsuna biyar.

accountability.label: Alhaki
accountability.body: Yawan amsoshi yana bayyane, don haka shiru daga ofis shi ma yana kan rikodin.

trust.label: Shaidar da aka tabbatar
trust.body: Ɗan ƙasa ɗaya da aka tabbatar, sa hannu ɗaya. Babu asusun yawa, babu jimlar da aka ƙara.

accessibility.label: Yana aiki a wayarka
accessibility.body: An gina shi don ya loda a wayar Android mai rahusa a kan hanyar sadarwa mai rauni.

principles.note: Kamar yadda bankin dijital ya sabunta yadda muke motsa kuɗi, CivicOS yana sabunta yadda muke shiga cikin dimokuradiyya — bayyane, mai samuwa, kuma an gina shi don ya dawwama.

steps.title: Daga rajista zuwa aikin jama'a cikin minti 3

join.title: Ƙirƙiri asusunka da aka tabbatar
join.body: Yi rajista da sunanka da bayanan asali. Tabbatarwa shi ne abin da ke tabbatar da cewa kowane sa hannu da rahoto na gaskiyar mazauni ne.

pick.meta: Zaɓi jiha, ƙaramar hukuma, da unguwa
pick.title: Zaɓi unguwarka da ƙaramar hukumarka
pick.body: Zaɓi jiharka, ƙaramar hukumarka, da unguwarka don jerinka ya kawo fitilun titi, hanyoyi, da matsalolin da suke gaban ƙofarka.

act.title: Shigar da matsala ko goyi bayan koƙe
act.body: Ɗauki hoton matsalar al'umma ko sa hannu kan koƙen mazauna. Ana sanya alamar lokaci a kan abin da ka aika kuma ana adana shi a rikodin jama'a.

follow.title: Biyo amsa a ainihin lokaci
follow.body: Ka samu sanarwa nan da nan idan wakili ya amsa, koƙe ya cimma burinsa, ko matsalar da aka shigar ta canza matsayi zuwa an warware.

faq.title: Amsoshi bayyanannu ga 'yan ƙasa da ma'aikatan gwamnati

cost.q: Shin CivicOS kyauta ne gaba ɗaya ga 'yan ƙasa?
cost.a: I, kullum. Bayar da rahoton matsaloli, sa hannu kan koƙe-koƙen gida, biyo wakilai, da karɓar sanarwar matsayi kai tsaye — duka babu kuɗi ga mazauna. Cibiyoyin gwamnati da NGOs na iya biya don kayan aiki na ci gaba, amma kwarewar ɗan ƙasa kyauta ce.

privacy.q: Yaya CivicOS ke kare bayanan sirri na?
privacy.a: Imel ɗinka, lambar wayarka, da adireshin gidanka suna a kebe kuma ba a taɓa raba su a bainar jama'a ba. Sunanka kawai da ayyukan jama'a da kake yi — matsalolin da ka shigar, koƙe-koƙen da ka sa hannu, sharhin da ka aika — suna bayyana a dandalin.

coverage.q: Me zai faru idan shugaban ƙaramar hukumarka ko wakilin unguwarka bai kasance a CivicOS ba tukuna?
coverage.a: Har yanzu kana iya shigar da matsaloli da fara koƙe-koƙe. Idan wani jami'in mazaɓarka ya shiga, rahotannin unguwarsu da suke akwai za su bayyana a dashboard ɗinsu ta atomatik — babu abin da ka shigar da zai ɓace.

reps.q: Shin wakilai da jami'an kansil suna amsawa a zahiri?
reps.a: Ana ɗaukar jami'ai unguwa-unguwa, kuma yawan amsoshinsu yana kan bayanin martabarsu na jama'a. Yana aiki ta hanyoyi biyu: idan ofis ya amsa, mazauna suna ganin sa, kuma idan ya yi shiru, shi ma yana kan rikodin.

abuse.q: Yaya kuke dakatar da asusun ƙarya, spam, da sa hannun bot?
abuse.a: Kowane asusu yana wucewa ta tabbatar da shaida. Koƙe-koƙe suna tilasta ƙa'idar ɗan ƙasa ɗaya, sa hannu ɗaya, kuma rahotannin da suke shigowa suna da iyaka kuma ana sarrafa su a kan ƙa'idodin al'umma.

ownership.q: Wa ke gudanar da CivicOS, kuma shin yana da alaƙa da wata jam'iyyar siyasa?
ownership.a: CivicOS fasahar jama'a ce mai zaman kanta, ba ta jam'iyya ba, an gina ta a kan lambar buɗaɗɗe. Babu jam'iyyar siyasa ko sha'awar kasuwanci da ke mallaka, tallafa, ko sarrafa ta, kuma lambar tana bayyane ga kowa ya bincika.

stories.title: Abubuwa uku da suke canzawa idan rikodin ya zama na jama'a

issues.title: Fitilar titi da ta lalace tana samun mai kula
issues.body: Mazaunin titin Dankande ya shigar da shi sau ɗaya, da hoto da wuri. Maƙwabta za su gan shi, ofishin ƙaramar hukuma zai gan shi, haka ma duk wanda ke tambaya me ya sa ya ɗauki makonni uku.

consultations.title: Shawarwarin da suke fitar da sakamako
consultations.body: Kansil yana buɗe taga kan ƙaura kasuwa, yana tara ra'ayoyi masu tsari daga 'yan kasuwa da mazauna, sannan yana sanya shawarar da dalilinta a wuri ɗaya.

reps.title: Amsar kansila ta daina zama jita-jita
reps.body: Idan wakili ya yi alkawarin ranar gyara, ana rubuta shi da alamar lokaci a bayanin martabarsa — don tambayar biyo baya ta samu abin da za ta nuna.

stewardship.title: Mai zaman kansa, ba na jam'iyya ba, kuma an gina shi a bayyane
stewardship.body: Ƙungiya ƙarama mai zaman kanta ce ke kula da CivicOS, ba jam'iyya ko ɗan kwangila ba. Duk lambar, tsarin bayanai, da API suna bayyane — kowa zai iya karanta yadda ake adana rahoto, wa zai iya gani, da abin da ke faruwa bayan an shigar da shi.

openSource.title: Kowa zai iya bincika
openSource.body: Kowane sabis, ƙaura, da hanyar API tana zama a wurin ajiya na jama'a ƙarƙashin lasisin buɗaɗɗe. Idan kana son duba yadda ake sarrafa bayananka, karanta lambar.

invite.title: Muna buɗewa unguwa-unguwa
invite.body: CivicOS tana fitowa al'umma-al'umma maimakon yin da'awar kula da ƙasa gaba ɗaya wanda ba ta da shi. Idan kai shugaban ƙungiyar al'umma ne ko kuma kana aiki a ofishin ƙaramar hukuma, za ka iya kawo unguwarka da wuri.

contribute.title: Ana maraba da gudummawa
contribute.body: Masu haɓaka software, masu fassara, da masu binciken jama'a za su iya buɗe batu ko neman haɗawa. Takardun sun rufe tsarin gine-gine, saitin gida, da tsarin bayar da gudummawa.

newsletter.title: Ka kasance da labarin CivicOS a jiharka
newsletter.sub: Imel ɗaya a kowane wata game da sabbin ƙananan hukumomin da muka isa, manyan nasarorin al'umma, da sabuntawar dandali. Babu spam, ka fita a kowane lokaci.
newsletter.doneSub: Za mu rubuta idan CivicOS ta isa ƙaramar hukumarka.

cta.title: A shirye kake ka sa al'ummarka ta ƙidaya a rikodin?
cta.sub: Shiga mazauna, shugabannin al'umma, da jami'an gwamnati waɗanda ke gina ƙaramar hukuma mai saurin amsawa da alhaki, tare.
cta.ctaSecondary: Yi haɗin gwiwa a matsayin ƙaramar hukuma ko wakili

manifesto.marker: Me ya sa muka gina wannan
manifesto.headline: An gina shi don gaskiyar ƙaramar hukuma.
manifesto.body: Mazauni ya bayar da rahoton bututun ruwa da ya fashe, sannan bai ji wani abu ba har watanni. Kansila ya gyara hanya, kuma babu wanda ke wajen unguwar ya sani. CivicOS shi ne rikodin da aka raba wanda ke rufe wannan gibin — gwamnatoci, jami'o'i, NGOs, da al'ummomi suna amfani da shi, an tsara shi kusa da wuraren da mutane suke zaune da gaske.

donate.anonymous: Bayar ba tare da suna ba
donate.platformFee: ban da kuɗin CivicOS na {{percent}}% wato {{fee}}
donate.noFee: Kowace naira za ta isa ga ƙungiyar — CivicOS ba ya karɓar kuɗi.
donate.submitting: Ana buɗe tsarin biyan kuɗi mai aminci…
donate.paystackNote: Za ka kammala a shafin biyan kuɗi mai aminci na Paystack. CivicOS ba ya ganin bayanan katinka.
donate.genericError: Ba a iya fara biyan kuɗin ba. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.

complete.title: Na gode
complete.body: Muna tabbatar da biyan kuɗinka tare da Paystack. Da zarar ya wuce, gudummawarka za ta bayyana a shafin kamfen — yawanci cikin minti ɗaya.
complete.receiptNote: Rasidi na zuwa imel ɗin da ka bayar. CivicOS ba ya ganin bayanan katinka.

accounting.heading: Inda kuɗin ya tafi
accounting.lede: Abin da wannan kamfen ɗin ya karɓa ta CivicOS, da abin da ƙungiyar ta ce ta kashe.
accounting.unreported: Ba a bayar da lissafi ba tukuna
accounting.progressLabel: Kashi {{percent}}% na kuɗin an ba da lissafinsa
accounting.percent: Kashi {{percent}}% na abin da ya shigo an ba da lissafinsa.
accounting.exceeds: Wannan ƙungiya ta ba da rahoton kashe fiye da abin da ta tara a nan. Hakan na iya faruwa idan an ƙara kuɗi daga wani wuri.
accounting.none: Wannan ƙungiya ba ta buga wani kashewa ba tukuna.
accounting.disclaimer: Ƙungiyar ce ke buga waɗannan alkaluman kashewa. Gudummawa na shiga asusun bankinsu kai tsaye, don haka CivicOS ba ya riƙe kuɗin kuma ba za mu iya tabbatar da waɗannan alkaluman da kanmu ba.

console.heading: Sarrafa wannan kamfen
console.lede: Ƙungiyarka kaɗai ke ganin wannan. Duk abin da ka buga a nan yana bayyana a shafin da ke sama, daidai yadda masu bayarwa ke karantawa.
console.descriptionLabel: A kan me aka kashe shi
console.descriptionHelp: Ka yi bayani sosai. Wannan shi ne abin da masu bayarwa ke karantawa don yanke shawarar amincewa da kai kuma.
console.spentAtHelp: Lokacin da kuɗin ya fita daga asusunka, ba yau ba.
console.receiptLabel: Hanyar haɗi zuwa rasit ko takardar kuɗi (na zaɓi)
console.spendPublished: An buga. Yanzu yana kan shafin jama'a.
console.spendNote: CivicOS ba zai iya tabbatar da waɗannan alkaluman ba — gudummawa na shiga asusun bankinka kai tsaye. Abin da ka buga a nan sanarwarka ce, ana nuna ta da sunanka.
console.withdrawNote: Cirewa yana kawar da shi daga shafin jama'a. Alkaluman asali suna nan a cikin littafin tantancewa.
console.attachmentsLabel: Hanyoyin haɗi zuwa hotuna ko takardu (na zaɓi)
console.attachmentsHelp: Hanyar haɗi ɗaya a kowane layi.
console.updatePublished: An aika. An sanar da masu bayarwa.
console.updateNote: Duk wanda ya ba da gudummawa ga wannan kamfen zai sami sanarwa.
console.noMilestones: Ƙara shirin kashewa ga wannan kamfen kafin ka bayar da rahoton kashewa.
console.genericError: Wani abu bai yi aiki ba. Ka sake gwadawa.

finalReport.heading: Rahoton ƙarshe
finalReport.fullyAccounted: An ba da lissafin kowace naira da aka tara ta CivicOS.
finalReport.partiallyAccounted: Ba a ba da lissafin {{amount}} na abin da aka tara ba lokacin da aka gabatar da wannan rahoton.

sorts.ENDING_SOON: Za su ƙare nan ba da jimawa

orgCampaigns.heading: Kamfen tara kuɗi
orgCampaigns.empty: Babu kamfen tukuna. Ƙirƙiri ɗaya don fara tara kuɗi.
orgCampaigns.draftHint: Har yanzu daftarin aiki ne. Ƙara shirin kashewa, sannan ka aika don bita.
orgCampaigns.summaryHint: Ana nunawa a katin kamfen. Aƙalla haruffa 10.
orgCampaigns.descriptionHint: Ka bayyana buƙatar da yadda za a yi amfani da kuɗin. Aƙalla haruffa 40.
orgCampaigns.milestoneLabel: Abu na farko a shirin kashewa
orgCampaigns.milestoneHint: Abin da sashen farko na kuɗin zai yi. Za ka iya ƙara wasu kafin aikawa.
orgCampaigns.emergencyLabel: Wannan gaggawa ce — a yi bita da sauri
orgCampaigns.reviewNote: An adana kamfen ɗinka a matsayin daftari. Zai bayyana ga jama'a ne kawai bayan wani mai gudanarwa na CivicOS ya bita ya amince.
orgCampaigns.createError: Ba a iya ƙirƙirar kamfen ba. Ka duba fom ɗin ka sake gwadawa.
orgCampaigns.actionError: Ba a iya kammala wannan aikin ba.
orgCampaigns.updateError: Ba a iya ajiye canje-canjen ba. Ka sake gwadawa.
orgCampaigns.allocated: An raba {{allocated}} daga cikin {{goal}} a shirin.
orgCampaigns.planError: Ba a iya sabunta shirin kashewa ba.
orgCampaigns.allComplete: An yi wa kowane mataki alamar kammala.
orgCampaigns.exceedsGoal: Wannan ya fi {{remaining}} da ya rage. Ka rage shi, ko ka ƙara burin.
orgCampaigns.reportBodyLabel: Me wannan kamfen ya cim ma?
orgCampaigns.reportBodyHint: Aƙalla haruffa 40. Wannan shi ne lissafin da masu bayarwa za su karanta.
orgCampaigns.reportShortfall: Ba a ba da lissafin {{amount}} ba. Har yanzu za ka iya gabatarwa, amma za a buga wannan adadin tare da rahoton ka.
orgCampaigns.reportError: Ba a iya buga rahoton ba. Ka sake gwadawa.

orgCampaignCreate.title: Sabon kamfen
orgCampaignCreate.subtitle: An adana shi a matsayin daftari. Zai bayyana ga jama'a ne kawai bayan mai gudanarwa na CivicOS ya bita ya amince.

payout.heading: Asusun karɓar kuɗi
payout.connectedNote: Gudummawar kamfen ɗinku na shiga nan. CivicOS ba ya riƙe kuɗin.
payout.notConnected: Ba a haɗa asusun karɓar kuɗi ba. Kamfen ɗinku ba za su iya karɓar gudummawa ba sai kun ƙara ɗaya.
payout.outstandingHeading: Abin da ya rage kafin ku karɓi gudummawa
payout.banksError: Ba a iya loda jerin bankuna ba. Ka sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
payout.accountHelp: Lambobi 10. Ana aika zuwa Paystack don tabbatar da asusun — CivicOS ba ya adana ta.
payout.businessHelp: Sunan da aka buɗe asusun da shi.
payout.emailLabel: Imel ɗin tuntuɓar biyan kuɗi (na zaɓi)
payout.privacyNote: Ana aika lambar asusun ku zuwa Paystack sau ɗaya kuma CivicOS ba ya adana ta. Sunan banki da lambobi huɗu na ƙarshe kawai ake ajiyewa.
payout.error: Ba a iya haɗa wannan asusun ba. Duba banki da lambar asusu.

report.buttonAria: Kai rahoton wannan abun ciki ga masu daidaitawa
report.intro: Masu daidaitawa suna duba kowane rahoto. Rahoton ƙarya na iya haifar da takura kan asusunka.
report.reasonLegend: Me ke damun wannan abun ciki?
report.descriptionLabel: Akwai wani abu da ya kamata su sani? (na zaɓi)
report.descriptionPlaceholder: misali: wannan sharhi ya ambaci sunan wani mutum kuma yana ɓatarwa

SPAM.label: Spam
SPAM.hint: Talla mara buƙata, hanyoyin da ba su dace ba, ko saƙonni masu yawa.

ABUSE.label: Cin zarafi ko tsangwama
ABUSE.hint: Kai hari kan mutum, barazana, ko tsangwama kai tsaye.

MISINFO.label: Bayanan ƙarya
MISINFO.hint: Da'awar ƙarya game da mutane ko abubuwan da suka faru.

HATE.label: Maganar ƙiyayya
HATE.hint: Kai hari kan asali — kabila, addini, jinsi, yanayin sha'awa.

OTHER.label: Wani abu dabam
OTHER.hint: Bai dace da waɗanda ke sama ba — bayyana a ƙasa.

FUNDS_MISUSE.label: Ana iya ɓata kuɗi
FUNDS_MISUSE.hint: Kashe kuɗin da aka bayar bai dace da abin da ke faruwa ba.

WORK_NOT_DONE.label: Ba a yi aikin ba
WORK_NOT_DONE.hint: Tallafin ya ce yana ci gaba, amma babu abin da ya canza a ƙasa.

MISREPRESENTED.label: Tallafin bai faɗi gaskiya ba
MISREPRESENTED.hint: An ƙara girman buƙatar, an riga an cika ta, ko kuma ba gaskiya ba ce.

NO_UPDATES.label: Ƙungiyar ta yi shiru
NO_UPDATES.hint: An tara kuɗi kuma ba a ba da rahoto ba tun daga lokacin.

success.title: An karɓi rahoto
success.body: Mai daidaitawa zai duba shi nan ba da jimawa ba. Na gode da taimakawa wajen kiyaye gaskiya.

errors.alreadyFlagged: Ka riga ka kai rahoton wannan. Mai daidaitawa zai duba shi.
errors.emailNotVerified: Tabbatar da adireshin imel ɗinka kafin kai rahoto. Duba akwatin saƙonninka — ko je Bayanan Sirri don sake aikawa.
errors.rateLimited: Ka aika rahotanni da yawa kwanan nan. Sake gwadawa cikin daƙiƙa {{seconds}}.
errors.generic: Ba a iya aika rahoton ba. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.
errors.notEligible: Mutanen da suka ba da gudummawa ga wannan tallafin, ko waɗanda ke zama a yankin da yake hidima, ne kaɗai za su iya ƙara damuwa.
errors.descriptionRequired: Da fatan za a bayyana abin da ka gani, aƙalla jimla ɗaya.

report.campaignIntro: Bayyana damuwarka game da yadda ake gudanar da wannan tallafin. Damuwar tana zuwa ga ma'aikatan CivicOS, ba ga ƙungiyar ba. Ba abin da zai faru da tallafin ta atomatik — mutum yana duba kowanne.
report.campaignDescriptionPlaceholder: misali: ba a taɓa wurin rijiyar ba tun watan Afrilu, amma sabuntawa ta ƙarshe ta ce an gama haƙa

campaignAi.genericError: CivicAI bai iya rubuta wannan ba. Har yanzu kana iya rubuta shi da kanka.

draftCampaign.title: Bari CivicAI ya tsara
draftCampaign.hint: Bayyana matsalar da kalmominka. CivicAI zai mai da ita tallafin da za ka iya gyarawa.
draftCampaign.placeholder: misali: Rijiyarmu a Tudun Wada ta lalace a watan Mayu. Kimanin gidaje 90 yanzu suna tafiya kilomita 3 don ruwa. Muna buƙatar sauya famfo da gyara bango.
draftCampaign.suggestedPlan: Shirin kashe kuɗi da aka ba da shawara
draftCampaign.planNote: Ba a aiwatar ba — ƙara matakai da kanka domin jimillar ta zama taka.

donorUpdate.title: Bari CivicAI ya tsara
donorUpdate.hint: Faɗa wa CivicAI abin da ya faru. Zai rubuta sabuntawa ga waɗanda suka ba da gudummawa.
donorUpdate.placeholder: misali: Mun gama binciken wurin mun kuma share tarkace. Bututun sun jinkirta saboda mai kaya ya ƙare.

completionReport.title: Bari CivicAI ya tsara
completionReport.hint: Faɗa wa CivicAI yadda aikin ya ƙare. Zai tsara rahoton rufewa.
completionReport.placeholder: misali: An sake gina magudanar ruwa kuma motoci suna amfani da hanya. Mun kashe ƙasa da yadda aka shirya saboda al’umma sun ba da aiki kyauta.
completionReport.shortfall: {{amount}} na abin da ka tara har yanzu ba a bayyana ba. Shigar da rahoto yanzu zai adana wannan adadin har abada a shafinka na jama’a, ko da ka ba da rahoton ƙarin kashe kuɗi daga baya.

orgAnalytics.heading: Nazarin tallafi
orgAnalytics.lede: Yadda tallafinka ke tafiya. Duk abin da ke nan kuɗi ne da ya shigo ta CivicOS — gudummawa tana zuwa asusunka kai tsaye, don haka wannan ba ma'auni ba ne.
orgAnalytics.donorFloor: Daga cikin gudummawa {{total}}, {{attributable}} ne za a iya danganta su da mutum. An ba da sauran ba tare da shiga ba, don haka adadin masu bayarwa mafi ƙaranci ne, ba jimilla ba.
orgAnalytics.trendCaption: Kowane mako, tsofaffi da farko. Mako mafi kyau {{peak}}.
orgAnalytics.completionHint: Daga cikin tallafi {{published}} da ka wallafa, {{completed}} sun kammala.
orgAnalytics.reportingHint: Daga cikin {{completed}} da suka ƙare, {{reported}} sun zo da bayanin kuɗin.
orgAnalytics.loadError: Ba a iya loda nazari a yanzu ba.
orgAnalytics.emptyBody: Da zarar ka wallafa tallafi kuma gudummawa ta fara shigowa, nan za ka ga yadda yake tafiya.

repAnnouncements.heading: Sanarwa
repAnnouncements.ownerHint: Wannan shafinka ne. Daftari yana sirri har sai ka wallafa; wallafawa yana sanar da duk wanda ke bin ka.
repAnnouncements.saveError: Ba a iya ajiye wannan sanarwa ba.
repAnnouncements.draftNote: Ajiyewa yana sa ta zama sirri. Wallafawa aiki ne daban.
repAnnouncements.titlePlaceholder: Me kake son gaya wa mutanenka?
repAnnouncements.bodyPlaceholder: Rubuta a sarari. Mutane za su karanta a waya.
repAnnouncements.emptyBody: Idan ya yi, zai bayyana a nan — kuma za a sanar da kai idan kana bin sa.
repAnnouncements.emptyOwnerTitle: Ba ka wallafa komai ba tukuna
repAnnouncements.emptyOwnerBody: Rubuta sanarwa ka gaya wa mutanen da kake wakilta abin da kake yi.
